data.name: ScanTimedOut
data.value: The scan did not finish in time and was stopped.

data.name: SearchToolTip
data.value: Filter the list by file name or address. Esc clears it.

data.name: SettingsCloseToTray
data.value: Closing the window keeps it running in the notification _area

data.name: SettingsConcurrent
data.value: _Simultaneous downloads in total, across all queues (1–50)

data.name: SettingsConfirmBrowser
data.value: Ask for confirmation for downloads sent by the browser extension

data.name: SettingsConnectionsHint
data.value: The number of connections applies to downloads started after saving. The limit of simultaneous files of each queue is set in Queues.

data.name: SettingsFfmpegLabel
data.value: ffmpeg, to join audio and video into an MP4 (_empty = look in PATH)

data.name: SettingsFfmpegNone
data.value: ffmpeg not found in PATH: videos will be saved as .ts or as separate tracks. ffmpeg is not included in the app.

data.name: SettingsFolderHint
data.value: Categories with a relative folder (for example "Video") create a subfolder here.

data.name: SettingsGlobalQuota
data.value: Global _quota in MB per hour (0 = none)

data.name: SettingsHashHint
data.value: An expected hash given when adding the download (or in its properties) is always checked, even with this option off.

data.name: SettingsHashOnCompletion
data.value: Compute the hash of every completed file

data.name: SettingsNotify
data.value: Show a Windows notification when a download completes

data.name: SettingsPortableHost
data.value: Connect the browser extension to this portable copy (registers it as the browsers' native messaging host)

data.name: SettingsPortableStartupWarning
data.value: Portable version: the start entry points to {0}. If you move or rename this folder, Baton will no longer start with Windows: turn the option off and on again from the new place.

data.name: SettingsRestoreHint
data.value: After an update the previous version stays next to the program: if the new one has problems you can go back.

data.name: SettingsRunAtStartup
data.value: Start Baton with _Windows, minimized to the notification area

data.name: SettingsScanCodes
data.value: Exit codes that mean a threat (separated by commas)

data.name: SettingsScanHint
data.value: The downloaded file is never opened or run: it is only passed to the antivirus. A check that exceeds the maximum time is stopped.

data.name: SettingsScanOnCompletion
data.value: Check every completed file with the antivirus

data.name: SettingsUpdateHint
data.value: For example https://api.github.com/repos/USER/REPOSITORY/releases/latest, or a JSON file with version, notes, url and sha256. No update is downloaded without confirmation, and the program is replaced only if its SHA-256 matches.

data.name: StartupWarning
data.value: A queue is scheduled, but Baton does not start with Windows: schedules work only while the app is open (also when minimized to the notification area).

data.name: StatusBar
data.value: {0} of {1} queues running · {2} downloading · {3} waiting · {4} in total

data.name: ToolbarHint
data.value: Tick the buttons to show and put them in the order you like (Alt+Up/Down moves, Space shows or hides). Buttons after the flexible space go to the right.

data.name: ToolbarSpacer
data.value: ↔ flexible space (the buttons after it go to the right)

data.name: TrayHiddenHint
data.value: Baton keeps running here to finish downloads and scheduled queues. Use “Exit” in the menu to close it.

data.name: UpdateConfirmRestore
data.value: Restore the previous version? The program will close and open again.

data.name: UpdateConfirmRestoreLegacy
data.value: The previous version is still called DownloadManager: it will come back and use its data as it was when you moved to Baton (downloads added later stay only in Baton). Continue?

data.name: UpdateErrorAddress
data.value: The update address must be an https address.

data.name: UpdateErrorBadSignature
data.value: Version {0} is not installed: its signature is not valid or not made by a known key. The file may have been tampered with; download it only from the official page.

data.name: UpdateErrorHashMismatch
data.value: The downloaded file does not match its SHA-256: it was deleted.

data.name: UpdateErrorNoExe
data.value: The version does not contain the program (.exe).

data.name: UpdateErrorNoHash
data.value: The version does not give the program's SHA-256 (or an https address to download it): it is not offered.

data.name: UpdateErrorNoRelease
data.value: The update address does not return a valid version.

data.name: UpdateErrorNoShaAsset
data.value: Version {1} is not installed: the release does not contain the asset {0} with the program's SHA-256 (or it holds no valid hash), so the downloaded file could not be verified. It must be added to the release on GitHub.

data.name: UpdateErrorNoSignature
data.value: Version {1} is not installed: the author's signature ({0}) is missing. Since 1.1.0 the app installs only signed updates.

data.name: UpdateErrorNotProgram
data.value: The downloaded file is not a Windows program: it was deleted.

data.name: UpdateErrorTooLarge
data.value: The server's response is too large.

data.name: UpdateNoPrevious
data.value: There is no previous version to restore.

data.name: UpdateNone
data.value: No updates: version {0} is the latest.

data.name: UpdateNotInstalled
data.value: This copy of the program cannot update itself (it is not the version published as a single file).

data.name: UpdateRestoreSchema
data.value: The previous version uses an older database than this one: restoring it would lose the download list. To go back, install it separately with a copy of the data.

data.name: UpdateRolledBack
data.value: The new version did not start correctly: the previous version was restored.

data.name: UpdateUrlToolTip
data.value: Use a new link for the same file (for example when the old one has expired) keeping the data already downloaded

data.name: UrlCheckFailed
data.value: The new address does not respond: {0}

data.name: UrlCheckNoRanges
data.value: the new server does not allow resuming the download

data.name: UrlCheckNothingToKeep
data.value: No data has been downloaded yet.

data.name: UrlCheckSameDate
data.value: Same size and same last-modified date.

data.name: UrlCheckUnverifiable
data.value: the server reports the same size but gives neither an ETag nor a last-modified date

data.name: UrlUpdatedKept
data.value: Address updated: the data already downloaded ({0}) was kept.

data.name: UrlUpdatedRestart
data.value: Address updated: the download will start over.

data.name: WaitingProxyLogin
data.value: Waiting for the credentials of the proxy {0}
